description: This file declares the 'Underflow' class within the 'firebolt::rialto::server::tasks::generic' namespace. The class is a task related to handling underflow events in a media player context, including references to context, player, client, and source type. It provides a constructor, destructor, and an execute method, along with a private method to check if all sources have reached end-of-stream.
